articles.title: Fold Like a NASA Engineer: It's National Paper Airplane Day!
articles.summary: May 26 is National Paper Airplane Day! Did you know the longest paper airplane throw ever was 252.6 feet—longer than a basketball court? NASA even has designs you can fold yourself.

articles.title: Double Boosters! Artemis 2 Rocket Parts Separate in Perfect Sync
articles.summary: NASA's Artemis 2 moon mission captured an amazing photo of its two boosters separating at the same time. These boosters gave 75% of the power needed to escape Earth's gravity before falling away.

articles.title: This Ancient Fish Brain Holds Secrets to How Animals First Walked
articles.summary: Scientists used special scans to look inside the skull of a 380-million-year-old fish fossil from Antarctica. Its brain had features similar to the first animals that crawled onto land.
